Subject: Monthly Update — August 2026

This month was strong across most metrics.

**Revenue:** ARR hit $950K — just under $1M, but accurate. We'll update when we cross the threshold.

**Growth:** Users up 22% month over month, driven primarily by the new referral program.

**Churn:** Improved from 4.2% to 2.8% — the lowest we've ever seen. We attribute this to the new onboarding flow and weekly check-in emails.

**Team:** Two new hires starting September 1 — a senior engineer from Stripe and a Head of Marketing from Typeform.

**Financials:** Burn rate is $240K/month. We have 18 months of runway at current burn.

**Next milestone:** $1M ARR, expected in Q4.

**Key risk:** Enterprise sales cycle length has extended from 45 to 65 days on average.
